{"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"---"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE :-
1) TO BE CASE HARDENED UPTO 56~60 HRC.
2) CASE DEPTH 0.8~1.2mm.
3) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT.
4) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The title block heat treatment field is marked '---' while note N3 specifies case hardening to 56–60 HRC, creating a contradiction that could cause the shop to skip heat treatment. The designer should update the title block to reference note N3 or state the required heat treatment directly.","recommended_correction":"Change the title block heat_treatment field from '---' to match note N3 (e.g., 'CASE HARDEN 56-60 HRC, SEE N3')."},{"rule_id":"NM-008","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N2","page":1,"quote":"ÉBAVUREZ TOUS LES TROUS NON SPÉCIFIÉS ET LES BORDS TRANCHANTS."},{"kind":"note","ref":"N5","page":1,"quote":"MATÉRIEL : 20mNcR5
FINITION :  I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)
MACHINES :
POIDS (Kg): 2.15 kg"}],"comment":"Notes N2 and N5 are French translations of notes N1 and N4; if this drawing is not intended for a bilingual release they are extraneous copies that clutter the drawing and risk confusion. The designer should remove the duplicate-language notes unless a bilingual requirement applies.","recommended_correction":"Remove notes N2 and N5 if the drawing is English-only, or formally designate them as required bilingual text."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D14","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 50 H7 +0.025"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N4","page":1,"quote":"MATERIAL: 20mNcR5
FINISH: I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)
MACHINING:
WEIGHT(Kg ): 2.15 kg"}],"comment":"The ⌀50 H7 bore (D14) is a tight bearing-seat fit, but note N4 calls out an I.Z.B.P. plating finish without any allowance for the plating thickness on that dimension. Plating buildup will shrink the bore below H7 limits and prevent proper bearing assembly. The designer should either specify the bore size before plating so the finished size falls within H7, or add a note masking the bore during plating.","recommended_correction":"Add a pre-plate dimension for the ⌀50 H7 bore that accounts for I.Z.B.P. thickness, or add a note to mask the bore during plating."}]}
